name: bowser-ci-tools
description: CLIs the workflows run (app-ci, app-ota-legacy), locked here so every install is checked against package-lock.json instead of resolved fresh by npx. Move a version on purpose: edit it, regenerate the lock (npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts), and say why in CHANGELOG.md. typescript is pinned so its two optional peers (ts-node, @expo/require-utils) agree; without it npm ci rejects the lock.
